{{Otheruses|singularity}}
The '''singularity projector''' was a device of unknown technology that apparently made a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] "disappear". This unit actually folded space around the droid, ripping it out of normal space. The resulting outcome was considered well worth any possible compatibility dangers.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[G0-T0]] is able to equip this item.
